decision.explanation: Three distinct claims exist in the provided sources regarding when Ralph Cole was elected to the Ohio House of Representatives. Each is supported by its own source and refers to a different Ralph Cole based on contextual clues: (1) D1S3 supports 1954 for a Ralph Cole representing Hancock County; (2) D3S1 and D4S5 support 1900 for a Ralph Cole who served from 1900–1904; and (3) D2S2 supports 1972 for another Ralph Cole. These are treated as separate valid referents due to differing contexts and timelines.
